_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.
_as_of: 2026-07-15 · Session 117 (StarMarcus) — the merge/mint doctrine's LAST open forks closed (now v0.13); the ESL packaging DRY-RUN shipped (2,364 → 3 comprehensives + carve-outs), ready to apply

Two small scenario batches closed every remaining open rule question — Sam swept all six with the recommended calls: Honors folds into its base course (but standalone honors-program courses stay); a big spread of unit-counts on a non-standardized course means a whole course got lumped with its own pieces (split them, don't just cap); cross-discipline groups with the same subject code merge to that subject's canonical field; and of the variant marks, Lab folds while Refresher and Bridge stay their own courses. The doctrine is now v0.13 with EVERY named open fork resolved. Then the payoff: the ESL packaging dry-run maps the real 2,364 ESL courses to Beginning/Intermediate/Advanced ESL (2,149) plus three carve-outs kept separate — Citizenship (38), Vocational ESL (155), and Transfer-level (22, held for Sam because there's no transferable flag in the data). It WROTE NOTHING — it's a plan to eyeball first. NEXT: Sam skims the plan (and confirms the 22 transfer candidates), then the ESL apply lands (Rule 9), then the whole-worklist batch-apply and wave 4 (both staged).

items.text: 🆕 The ESL packaging DRY-RUN is ready to eyeball (kb/esl_package_out/2026-07-15/esl_package_report.md + the visual). 302 'Subject-code outlier (likely mis-mint)' rows behind the Triage-dropdown filter — each carries a suggested discipline (the local subject code's usual field). Review + bulk re-discipline the clear ones. The HVAC family (41) already fired; this is the rest, and it feeds wave 4.

Wire kb/crnc_mirrors.json into the auditor (kb/_row_audit.py) + CCR scanner so the D-3 'credit_mixed' flag is SUPPRESSED for the 1,337 mirror identities (they're CPL Credit-by-Exam pairings, not over-merges) — stops wave 4+ from re-flagging them. Add kb/_detect_crnc_mirrors.py to the post-apply chain.

Fix top_categories.json parse gaps — ~30 legit TOP codes dropped leave 6,495 rows at cte:null (Music 1004, Sociology 2208, Art 1002.1x). Re-parse, re-run _join_cte_from_top.py (heals them), and fold that join into the post-apply chain (nothing re-stamps cte today).

~100 TOP-driven homonym splits still need a re-check against title/description/aligned-exhibit (P-12: TOP only tips the scales when the other three are inconclusive) before they fire. Ride into a wave-4 re-verify pass.
